products.title: Thunderbolt 4 Docking Station
products.description: This Thunderbolt 4 Certified docking station offers high-performance connectivity for Windows laptops and MacBooks. It allows users to expand their workspace using a single Thunderbolt 4, Thunderbolt 3, or USB4 port, providing a wide range of ports including three downstream Thunderbolt 4/USB4 ports, three USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A ports, a Gigabit Ethernet port, and an SD 4.0/UHS-II card reader. With 96W Power Delivery, it can efficiently charge compatible laptops while supporting dual 4K 60Hz monitors or a single 8K 30Hz display.

products.title: SIIG Thunderbolt 4 Docking Station
products.description: The SIIG JU-DK0U11-S1 is a high-performance Thunderbolt 4 docking station designed to create a comprehensive workstation for MacBook Pro, Windows (Intel, AMD, Snapdragon), and Chromebooks. It features 15 connecting ports in total, providing massive data transfer speeds up to 40Gbps. The dock supports advanced display configurations, including a single 8K output or up to four 4K displays using a combination of Thunderbolt 4, DisplayPort, and HDMI (via DisplayLink technology). It provides 60W Power Delivery to charge laptops, along with dedicated charging for USB-A ports and Thunderbolt 4 ports. Additional connectivity includes a Gigabit Ethernet port and dual memory card readers (SD 3.0 UHS-1 and Micro SD 3.0 UHS-1) supporting capacities up to 2TB.

products.title: Thunderbolt 4 Docking Station with DisplayLink
products.description: Revolutionize your workspace with the Satechi Thunderbolt 4 Dock with DisplayLink. This professional docking station allows you to connect up to four external 4K/60Hz monitors (two via Thunderbolt 4 and two via HDMI). It offers high-speed data transfer up to 40Gbps through three Thunderbolt 4 ports and up to 10Gbps via two USB-A 3.2 ports. The dock provides up to 96W USB-C PD charging for your laptop, a UHS-II SD 4.0 card reader reaching speeds up to 312MB/s, and Gigabit Ethernet for a stable internet connection. It is compatible with a wide range of devices, including MacBook Air/Pro M5/M4, iMac M4, Mac Mini M4, Mac Studio M4, and various Windows PCs.

products.title: Aegis Thunderbolt 4 Docking Station
products.description: The Apricorn Aegis Thunderbolt 4 Docking Station (ATB4DS) is a high-performance connectivity hub designed to expand the capabilities of Windows and macOS laptops. It features a Thunderbolt 4 host port that delivers up to 96W of power to charge your device while connecting peripherals. The dock is equipped with two Thunderbolt 4 accessory ports, four 10 Gb/s USB-A ports (one supporting BC1.2), an HDMI 2.1 port capable of supporting a single 8K 30Hz monitor or dual 4K 60Hz monitors, an SD 4.0 UHS-II card reader, and a 2.5 Gb/s RJ45 Ethernet port. For security, it includes dual Kensington security slots (MicroSaver and Slim NanoSaver).

products.title: Belkin Thunderbolt 4 Docking Station
products.description: The Belkin Pro Thunderbolt 4 Docking Station is a high-performance 12-in-1 hub designed to transform a laptop into a full desktop setup. It offers a massive 40 Gbps bandwidth and provides up to 90W Power Delivery to charge connected laptops. This versatile dock supports triple monitor setups up to 8K @ 30Hz and is certified for Thunderbolt 4 and USB4, while remaining backward compatible with Thunderbolt 3 and USB-C devices. Its comprehensive port selection includes dual HDMI, Thunderbolt 4, USB-C, multiple USB-A ports, an SD card reader, an audio jack, and Gigabit Ethernet, making it ideal for creative studios and hybrid work environments.

products.title: Wavlink Thunderbolt 4 Docking Station
products.description: The WAVLINK UTD43Pro is a professional-grade 12-in-1 Thunderbolt 4 docking station designed to enhance laptop connectivity and productivity. It features a powerful Thunderbolt 4 upstream port providing up to 98W Power Delivery (PD) and data speeds up to 40Gbps. The dock supports high-resolution visuals, allowing for either a single 8K@30Hz display or dual 4K@60Hz displays. Connectivity is extensive, including three downstream Thunderbolt 4 ports, a 10Gbps USB-C port with 30W PD, four USB-A ports (two 10Gbps and two 5Gbps), a 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet port, an SD 4.0 UHS-II card reader, and a 3.5mm audio jack. Encased in a heat-conducting aluminum alloy shell with integrated ventilation holes, it is compatible with Windows 10/11 and macOS 11 or later.

products.title: Revodok Max Thunderbolt Docking Station
products.description: This UGREEN docking station offers a comprehensive 13-in-1 connectivity solution for your devices. With Thunderbolt 4 technology, it delivers blazing-fast 40Gbps speeds for data transfer and supports dual 4K@60Hz displays or a single 8K@30Hz display. It provides up to 96W of power delivery to charge your laptop while keeping all connected peripherals powered by its 180W adapter. The fanless, silent cooling design and aluminum construction ensure a quiet and durable user experience, making it ideal for both professional and home office environments. Its versatile ports include multiple Thunderbolt 4 and USB-C ports, USB-A ports, SD/TF card readers, Gigabit Ethernet, and an audio jack.

products.title: j5create 8K Thunderbolt 4 Docking Station JTD562
products.description: The j5create 8K Thunderbolt 4 Docking Station (JTD562) is a high-performance workstation hub designed for Mac and Windows laptops. It allows users to expand their connectivity through a single Thunderbolt 4 cable, offering support for a single 8K display at 60 Hz or dual 4K displays at 60 Hz. The dock features three Thunderbolt 4 USB-C ports for high-speed data transfer (up to 40 Gb/s) and daisy-chaining, three USB-A 3.2 Gen 2 ports (up to 10 Gb/s), one USB-A 2.0 port, and a front-facing SD UHS-II card reader. It also includes Gigabit Ethernet and a 3.5mm audio combo jack. Additionally, it provides up to 96W Power Delivery to charge connected laptops and tablets.

products.title: RX-4 Raiden Thunderbolt 4 Docking Station
products.description: The BLACKJET 17-in-1 RX-4 Raiden is a high-performance Thunderbolt 4 docking station designed to transform a laptop into a full workstation. It features a Thunderbolt 4 host connection supporting 40 Gb/s data transfer and 60W Power Delivery. The dock is equipped with an extensive array of ports, including a secondary Thunderbolt 4 port, four USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 ports, three USB-A 3.2 Gen 1 ports, and two USB-A 2.0 ports. For video output, it provides HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4, capable of supporting resolutions up to 8K at 30 Hz. Additional features include UHS-II SD and microSD card readers, a 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet port, and a 3.5mm audio combo jack. It also supports Thunderbolt Share, allowing it to function like a KVM switch between two Windows-based Thunderbolt computers.
